settings.why_not_quadriflow: QuadriFlow needs closed manifold input and smooths thin features: every Tripo part is one shell with 264-2413 open edges (segmentation cuts), and the figure is mostly thin feather sheets (wing primaries, crest spikes, collar ruff) whose serrated outline is the silhouette; collapse decimation keeps those outlines (measured: surface distance high->low per part in h2-lowpoly-report.json)

profile.note: H2.1 metal base (proposal; UE not touched): the parametric base keeps its mesh, pips and vertex mask; UV0 re-laid by base_gold.uv_layout, own 1K texture set T_Harpy_H2_Base_{BC,N,ORM} (base_textures.py). UE route: M_UM_BaseMarker MI with BaseColorTexture/NormalTexture/ORMTexture = these, BaseColor (1,1,1), VertexMaskWeight 1 (team band + pips from the vertex mask), SideBandWeight 0, BandKeepsTexture 0, PipColor / PipEmissive as before. M_UM_BaseMarker takes Metallic = ORM.B and Roughness = lerp(RoughnessMin, RoughnessMax, ORM.G), so the texture carries the metal

band.why: bright gold (shows only with BandKeepsTexture 1; the default flat team band takes its ORM: metal)

top.why: antique gold / bronze leaf of the concept base (concept front, base median sRGB (0.66, 0.50, 0.26) = linear (0.39, 0.21, 0.06) as lit); kept darker than the lit pips (instance read: pip - top >= 40 luma, analyse_instances.py)

fill_102.why: H2.1 nape: the smooth dark cap_100 read as a bald hood inside the collar from every game camera (scratch HP probe 2026-09-29: cap pixels 210 441 over 8 game azimuths at pitch -55, ortho 0.22 m). The dark collar feathers right of the neck (tripo_part_1, box above; Tripo UVs and texture, 10.9k HP faces) are laid 14 times on the cap (8 on the dome and the V down the back, 6 around the rim lip), each copy conformed to the cap surface with its relief (x0.7) and turned so its feathers point down the nape / out over the collar; faces of a copy that fall wholly beyond the cap are dropped. Probe: cap pixels 210 441 -> 13 441 (-94 %). Proposal

rule.why: face islands (UV priority x2): base colour x (1 - 0.5 cavity - 0.6 dark detail), cavity = local AO deficit (gaussian 6 px of the 4K bake), dark detail = relative luminance below a 3 px blur (brows, lids, nostrils, lip line): darkening only, so the painted features keep their shape and survive the 2K mips at K2

feathers.metallic_note: texels with metallic > 0 inside the feather mask are the 3x3 soft edge of the gold bands (textures.metal_rule)

cap_100.why: closes the torso's neck opening left by repair.trim (and by the dropped tripo_part_12, whose neck filled it; harpy-h2-bake/1 closed only its lower back part with the ellipsoid plug_100 and left a see-through gap at the base of the head: 119-130 px at azimuth 180 / 4.8 m, measured by see_through.py). Closed domed cap on the loop's best-fit plane: skirt ring 12 % outside the loop and 4 mm under it (tucks under the collar), lip ring on the rim 3 mm up (a ray grazing the rim meets the cap before the rim's culled inner side), closed underside. Dark feather tone with a soft procedural scallop (Voronoi F1, baked into BC and N); prototypes 2026-09-29: ellipsoid plugs left 5-85 px see-through, the cap 0-1 px on the high-poly. Proposal

tripo_part_12.why: front-concept face of the Janus head (source -Y); after the 180 deg turn it would be a second face on the back of the head. Its neck sat in the hood/neck column of tripo_part_1 (see repair.trim)

fill_102.why: H2.1 nape: the smooth dark cap_100 read as a bald hood inside the collar from every game camera (scratch HP probe 2026-09-29: cap pixels 210 441 over 8 game azimuths at pitch -55, ortho 0.22 m). The dark collar feathers right of the neck (tripo_part_1, box above; Tripo UVs and texture, 10.9k HP faces) are laid 14 times on the cap (8 on the dome and the V down the back, 6 around the rim lip), each copy conformed to the cap surface with its relief (x0.7) and turned so its feathers point down the nape / out over the collar; faces of a copy that fall wholly beyond the cap are dropped. Probe: cap pixels 210 441 -> 13 441 (-94 %). Proposal

occluder_only_parts.tripo_part_7: Tripo base (gold cylinder, source Ø0.321 m): AO occluder under the feet only; the game base is the parametric SM_Harpy_Base (instance pips, team band)

tripo_part_1.why: hood / neck column of the torso that framed the dropped face tripo_part_12: faces with centroid above z 0.455 behind the head (authored frame, source scale; measured 2026-09-29: 15 829 of 266 455 high-poly faces, centroids x -0.055..0.057, y -0.026..0.070, z 0.455..0.534). Below z 0.455 the part is the collar ruff; the cut leaves one open loop around the neck (0.65 m, x -0.055..0.058, y -0.027..0.042, z 0.384..0.457), closed by repair.caps. Proposal

measured.why: Janus head of Tripo task 330872a3 (measured 2026-09-29, work/probe sheets): the side concept (drawn over ortho_left, face looking left) went into the RIGHT slot, so Tripo fitted a face on BOTH sides of the head (-Y: tripo_part_12 from the front concept; +Y: tripo_part_0 from the mirrored side profile) and swept the wings toward -Y. Turning the high-poly 180 deg about Z makes the side-consistent face (tripo_part_0, with a real nose/chin profile) the front and sweeps the wings back as in the side concept; the front-concept face part tripo_part_12 is dropped. The dropped face sat inside a feathered hood of the TORSO part tripo_part_1 (its neck column behind the head, authored y -0.026..0.070, rising to z 0.534 = eye level): that hood stays hollow after the drop (open toward +Y, its inside faces the viewer from behind) and reads from the elevated game camera as a smooth bald dome behind the crest (harpy-h2-bake/1 review, verifier frames 2026-09-29). Profile /2 trims it (repair.trim), closes the torso's neck opening with a closed cap (repair.caps) and covers the cap's upper half with a copy of the head's own back feathers (repair.patches). The back of tripo_part_0 itself is a closed feathered surface. The second ankle band tripo_part_11 (right leg after the turn) is kept because it is structural (see kept_parts_note). Repair of a generation defect, proposal; regeneration with the side view in the LEFT slot is the clean fix (followup)

see_through.label: blender Workbench mask (flat, no AA), not an UE frame
see_through.method: see_through_px = covered with both face sides AND NOT covered with back faces culled (M_UM_Figure TwoSided=false)

settings.note: the Tripo parts are one surface cut into parts: neighbouring high-poly parts share their cut vertex for vertex (12 part pairs, 36 shared chains, e.g. inner/outer right wing), but the per-part decimation moved each boundary on its own and opened sub-millimetre cracks. One-sided game-camera frames (see_through.py, 36 frames) of the unstitched game mesh: 212 see-through pixels, 0-15 per frame; stitched: 49, 0-4 per frame (measured 2026-09-29 on the harpy-h2-bake/2 mesh). Stitching projects both boundaries onto the high-poly cut, clusters vertices closer than merge_m, inserts the other part's vertices (~1.3k, +~1.3k triangles) and puts a vertex of both parts on every open chain end (three-part corners). max_edge_factor 3.0 folded a wing corner (max high->low distance of tripo_part_2 6.4 mm), 1.5 keeps it at 3.2 mm (unstitched 3.3 mm). Repair parts (cap, patch) are excluded: they overlap, they do not share cuts. Proposal

rule.why: face islands (UV priority x2): base colour x (1 - 0.5 cavity - 0.6 dark detail), cavity = local AO deficit (gaussian 6 px of the 4K bake), dark detail = relative luminance below a 3 px blur (brows, lids, nostrils, lip line): darkening only, so the painted features keep their shape and survive the 2K mips at K2

feathers.metallic_note: texels with metallic > 0 inside the feather mask are the 3x3 soft edge of the gold bands (textures.metal_rule)

rule.why: Tripo roughness 0.65-0.94 per part (p5-p95), mean 0.77, metallic 0: remapped into 0.70-0.85, half the part's own Tripo rank, half the baked AO (exposed vanes smoother, occluded roots rougher); face/ear skin (v > 0.45, s < 0.4 on the head part), the gold bands and the talons excluded

the claws are the desaturated dark texels of the feet parts (Tripo sRGB v 0.16-0.35, s < 0.3; the scale crevices are saturated brown): roughness 0.40 (dark) - 0.55 (lighter), metallic 0, base colour x0.75 toward the black horn of the concept

rule.note: Tripo PBR left the gold ankle bands non-metallic (metallic > 0.5 on 0 texels of the figure, measured 2026-09-29); the concept paints them as antique gold/bronze. Proposal: gold-coloured texels (sRGB hue 30-62 deg, s >= 0.45, v >= 0.45) of the two leg parts that carry a band get metallic 1.0 / roughness 0.35 with a soft 3x3 edge

W4-B rule of Harpy (harpy-segmented-skeletal/3 team_color.mask: no cloth; the dark flight feathers of the wings carry the team colour, v <= 0.22 on the sRGB BC, ramp 0.05, blur 3x3) applied to the four H2 wing parts. Format = W4-B TeamMask (separate 8-bit linear L texture, UE reads .R). Proposal

check.padding_requirement: free texels between islands >= 8 at 4096 px (texel centre distance >= 9)
check.texels_covered_twice_note: texels_covered_twice counts every texel centre the inclusive pixel-centre rasteriser gives to two triangles; texels_overlapping_strict counts only those strictly inside two triangles (a shared edge through a texel centre is a tie, not an overlap)
